recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20533; future changes to the security category model or to specific resource classifications should be handled under separate category-family Jira issues.
issue_request: FHIR-20533 was Published with a Persuasive FHIR-I decision for R5. It reported that the Resource Type Index Security Category - Individual list showed Practitioner and PractitionerRole, while security.html Individual Sensitive prose also mentioned CareTeam and other users, and requested that the narrative be brought into agreement with the definitions.
initial_application: The issue was directly applied by 784790d4b9354cad9b3f254937b8091beae9ab89, which changed source/security.html from mentioning Practitioners, PractitionerRole, CareTeam, or other users to only Practitioners and PractitionerRole.
additional_context: Current build-scope category data remains consistent: source/fhir.ini assigns practitioner and practitionerrole to individual and careteam to patient, and the corresponding StructureDefinition source files carry matching structuredefinition-security-category extensions. Related category-family audits FHIR-19302 and FHIR-20002 are already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-20002 and PA WGM minutes discuss the same CareTeam confusion and support treating CareTeam as patient context rather than adding it back to Individual.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/security.html Individual Sensitive paragraph names only Practitioner and PractitionerRole, while source/fhir.ini and the resource StructureDefinitions classify Practitioner/PractitionerRole as individual and CareTeam as patient, so the mismatch described by FHIR-20533 is already resolved in current build source.

related_jiras.note: Created the security/privacy category framework and is already represented on the combined branch by 3cbc55b0d06c28a06d4714a113344fb267901fa8.
Recorded broader security categorization feedback, including the CareTeam/Individual confusion, and is already represented on the combined branch by 385f47bae29974068e962514f640032943cc6019.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive issue requiring the Individual Sensitive narrative to agree with the Resource Type Index Individual category definitions.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes that the target state is consistency with Practitioner and PractitionerRole as the individual-category resources.

evidence_items.summary: Commit 'FHIR-20533 Security Category - Individual resource list' changed the Individual Sensitive sentence from including CareTeam and other users to only Practitioners and PractitionerRole.
evidence_items.learned: The seed request was explicitly applied to the authoritative narrative source.

evidence_items.summary: Current build-scope source names Practitioner and PractitionerRole in the Individual Sensitive paragraph, assigns practitioner/practitionerrole to individual, and assigns CareTeam to patient.
evidence_items.learned: The current source no longer has the mismatch reported by FHIR-20533.

evidence_items.summary: PA/FHIR-I minutes for security categorization feedback say the Individual description was confusing because it referenced CareTeam, which is patient context, even though CareTeam.participant may include practitioners.
evidence_items.learned: Related community context supports the current distinction between CareTeam as patient category and Practitioner/PractitionerRole as individual category.
